name: Philippine History & Civics
description: For learners, teachers, and everyone: key moments, heroes, and civic values of the Philippines - ideal for Araling Panlipunan review.

questions.prompt: Who is the national hero of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Jose Rizal, author of Noli Me Tangere, is the national hero.

questions.prompt: In what year was Philippine independence from Spain declared?
questions.explanation: Independence was declared on June 12, 1898 in Kawit, Cavite.

questions.prompt: What does the three stars on the Philippine flag represent?
questions.explanation: The three stars stand for Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

questions.prompt: Who was the first President of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Emilio Aguinaldo was the first President, of the First Republic.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Manila is the capital of the Philippines.

questions.prompt: The EDSA People Power Revolution happened in what year?
questions.explanation: People Power peacefully restored democracy in February 1986.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novels Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo?
questions.explanation: Rizal wrote both novels exposing abuses under Spanish rule.

questions.prompt: What is the highest law of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Constitution is the supreme law of the land.

questions.prompt: How many senators does the Philippines elect nationally?
questions.explanation: The Senate has 24 senators elected nationwide.

questions.prompt: Which hero is known as the "Brains of the Revolution"?
questions.explanation: Apolinario Mabini advised Aguinaldo and shaped revolutionary policy.

questions.prompt: What event on December 30, 1896 is commemorated as Rizal Day?
questions.explanation: Rizal was executed by firing squad in Bagumbayan (now Luneta).

questions.prompt: The Philippines is an archipelago of roughly how many islands?

questions.explanation: Andres Bonifacio founded the Katipunan in 1892.

questions.prompt: What is the term length of the Philippine President?
questions.explanation: The President serves one six-year term without reelection.

questions.prompt: Which language pair are the official languages of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Filipino and English are the official languages.
